mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Accountabilities (1): Automation & Performance QE Strategy
·       Own automation and performance QE strategy across complex platforms and high-impact technology initiatives.
·       Establish quality standards, automation governance, performance testing practices, quality gates, and release readiness criteria.
·       Drive maturity of automation frameworks, reusable test assets, performance practices, reporting, and engineering efficiency.
·       Oversee performance testing for critical journeys, APIs, integrations, services, and system components.
·       Provide senior quality recommendations based on automation coverage, performance results, defect trends, and release risks.
 
Key Accountabilities (2): Quality Governance, Risk & Improvement
·       Establish quality controls through monitoring, reporting, audit, root cause analysis, and post-release review.
·       Manage quality, performance, security, compliance, operational, and release risks across teams and vendors.
·       Improve quality metrics, dashboards, defect prevention, lessons learned, and continuous improvement practices.
·       Ensure testing tools, environments, access, test data, and automation processes meet quality and delivery standards.
·       Partners with Product Owner, Development Engineering, Business Unit, BA, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and vendors on quality-first decisions.
 
Key Accountabilities (3): People Leadership & QE Excellence
·       Lead, coach, and develop QE leads and engineers with strong focus on automation and performance capability.
·       Set team priorities, KPIs, delivery expectations, and quality standards aligned with business and technology objectives.
·       Build and retain a high-performing QE team through hiring, onboarding, feedback, coaching, and development planning.
·       Promote quality ownership, engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement across delivery teams.
·       Act as senior quality advisor for release of readiness, risk trade-offs, major defects, and improvement priorities.
